name: Multi-country and cross-border businesses (PK–UAE–Canada and beyond)
scope_rule: pi notes the operating problems of running across countries (time zones, currencies, duplicate systems). No tax residency, transfer pricing, or company-structure advice.

problems.phrase: numbers from each country in different systems
teams in different time zones miss handoffs

care: use each person’s own time zone for follow-ups; store currency per problem.
build_ideas: consolidated multi-entity reporting, transfer tracking between entities, shared task boards across offices.
